test_coverage_gaps.description: No explicit threshold table test for every grade boundary at scores 75, 60, 45, 30, and below 30.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: A future ladder edit could shift operator-facing A/B/C/D/F labels while component scoring still passes broad scenario tests.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Construct CampaignHealth scores around each threshold via applyCohortAdjustmentOnce or export/test grade behavior through deterministic computeCampaignHealth fixtures.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No fixture for unknown platform strings using DEFAULT_ROAS_PIVOT and DEFAULT_FALLBACK_TRUST.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: New ad platforms should degrade predictably instead of inheriting a broken pivot/trust path.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Aggregated fixture with platform "Pinterest", spend 500, conversionValue 1500, trueRevenueInfo undefined; expect Meta-like default pivot 3.0 and fallback trust 50%.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No direct test for negative or malformed numeric inputs from upstream aggregation.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: The scorer assumes production aggregation emits non-negative spend, revenue, and conversion counts; a parser regression upstream could produce misleading scores instead of failing clearly.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Aggregated fixtures with negative spend, negative conversionValue, or NaN-like values at the aggregator boundary.
